observations.name: Church of St. Cyril

floors.note: Visual count: two domestic upper rows above a church opening spanning the lower two levels; OSM fivefloor estimate does not describe facade.

observations.material: Unpainted warm red brick; restrained dark brown window sills/lintels; white arched entry trim
observations.cornice: Plain brick parapet with shallow central triangular gable; no tower or steeple
observations.fire_escape: No front escape on church itself; adjacent building escape intrudes at photo right edge
observations.entrance: Two flanking round-headed recessed entry arches and short iron-railed stoops. Right entrance has dark paired glazed doors with gold crosses and arched CHURCH OF ST CYRIL 62 lettering.
distinctive_details: Tall central round-headed stained-glass panel spans lower two levels; blue-green glazing divided into rectangular grid.
A narrow rectangular domestic window sits over each side entry; two rows of three rectangular sash windows above.
Facade is a narrow rowhouse scale with shallow center gable and no bell tower.
observations.verification: Entire primary facade inspected in official society linked Google Street View screenshot, perspective looking steeply upward

observations.name: Former St. Mary's American Orthodox Greek Catholic Church
observations.material: Gray-beige/yellow artificial coursed-stone veneer (Naturestone); dark charcoal window arches and tower roof
observations.cornice: Sloping low gable shoulders meet central square bell tower; steep small pyramidal roof and Orthodox cross. Existing roofline lacks the old stepped pinnacles.
observations.fire_escape: None on street front; rear fire escape appears in2025 condition photo
observations.entrance: Wide raised dark iron stoop with railings to wooden doors in left and middle round/pointed-top openings; right bay tall arched window and narrow areaway
distinctive_details: Very narrow22ft facade with three arched openings at each of three levels.
Central square tower rises about one window level above shoulders; single rectangular dark tower opening under small curved decorative hood.
Short pyramidal tower roof ends in multi-bar Orthodox cross; not a tall needle spire.
Existing gray layered stone veneer wraps facade and tower.
observations.verification: 2025 architect Existing Conditions photos directly inspected; primary2012profile corroborates3stories+basement+tower
